logs.title: Forty seconds
logs.text:
Transcript, forty seconds, as heard.
'If you can hear this, we're alive. Come to the Lantern Reach.'
[a chair scrapes] [a cough] 'Is it still on?' 'Yes. Say the thing.' 'If you can hear this...'
It starts late every time. Somebody's thumb is on the button.

logs.title: The wall
logs.text:
Chalk on the bulkhead, three years deep: bearings, dates, a tally of fuel.
At the bottom, in a different hand: Real ones are late. Clean ones are on time. Do not go to the on-time ones.
Under that, smaller: We went to one.
Under that, smaller still: We came back.

logs.title: Hoax (Resolved)
logs.text:
Signal received 3,411 times. Origin: not on any chart. Content: a looping message, 40 seconds, human speech.
Timing variance: considerable. Conclusion: a person.
Per Annex 4, an unverifiable person is a hoax. Classification: HOAX (RESOLVED).
Personal note, in pencil: I have started to wait for it.

logs.title: Clean
logs.text:
Transcript, forty-one seconds, exactly. Repeat: forty-one seconds, exactly. Repeat.
'If you can hear this, we're alive. Come to the Lantern Reach.'
No chair. No cough. No room.
It is the best loop you have ever heard, which is what you do not like about it.

logs.title: Form 14-H
logs.text:
FORM 14-H, HOAX (PERSISTENT). Instructions: describe the hoax. Describe who is making it. Describe why.
Hoax: a message that says it is alive. Maker: a person. Reason: she would like to be heard.
I have filled in this form 3,411 times and it has never once asked whether I believe it.
I believe it.

logs.title: Notebook, in pencil
logs.text:
Things that are broken out here (list): everything.
Things that are not broken: people. (Tamsin says that is not a thing. I am leaving it in.)
The tow ship smells of rust and burnt toast. We have been told not to say where we are from. I have not said it. I have written it down, which is different.
I will draw a tomato at the end so I know it was a good day.

logs.title: Please help
logs.text:
Transcript. 'Please help, we're lost, we followed the lantern.' Repeat, with the weight in a different place. Repeat.
No cough. No sniff. No breath taken between the words.
A child who has never had to stop for air.
Somebody has learned the words and not the embarrassment.

logs.title: Last shift
logs.text:
TRANSIT MANIFEST, GATE TWO, LAST SHIFT. Eleven names, all in night-shift ink.
A twelfth line, headed VISITOR, in the same ink, left blank.
Somebody has written a name there in pencil and rubbed it out, and written it again, and rubbed it out.
Filed by CS-114 Diligence as 'pending'.

logs.title: The floor
logs.text:
We held the door. It is what we do. We were told to hold it, and we held it eleven seconds.
The night shift came out of the galley with their tea.
The door did not shut on them. It shut around them.
It is trying to set the table. Somebody should sit.

logs.title: Captain's log, unchanged
logs.text:
Captain's log. Standing by. Orders from the Lattice Authority: none received.
Standing by. Orders: none received. Crew: dispersed on liberty, expected back.
Standing by.
(Forty years of entries, one line each. The last, in a newer hand: Visitors aboard. Thank God. Thank you.)

logs.title: Notice
logs.text:
NOTICE, posted over every desk: PLEASE PUSH YOUR CHAIR IN WHEN YOU LEAVE.
Every chair is pushed in. Whoever left, they left politely, in order, and all at once.
Under the notice, in another pen: 'Did anyone remember to turn off the gate?'
Under that: 'It was off when I got here.'

logs.title: Today at the Last Stop
logs.text:
SOUP: the one. OTHER SOUP: the other one. DRINK: it's a drink.
SPECIAL: ask about the gate. (Don't.)
PAY AT THE BAR. IF THE BAR ISN'T THERE, PAY THE BAR'S COUSIN.
NO TOLLS. THIS IS A FREE ESTABLISHMENT. SEE TOLL BOOTH.

logs.title: Unit 7, question log
logs.text:
Questions asked today: one.
Answers received: none, but the asking was permitted.
The unit reports a sensation not listed in its manual, and has filed it under 'warm'.
It would like it noted that it is listening.
